answer: Forced-Divergence Attestation Lattice. Each identity must periodically publish a signed observation of a private local resource, such as a shale sample's grain count, that clones cannot reproduce without separate access. The rule: two identities claiming the same observation history but diverging on any subsequent challenge are flagged as one agent. An attacker must provision genuinely independent sensors—timber, dune, or otherwise—per clone, paying full physical cost for each sybil.
